lineupAndAvailabilityStatus.note: This is a checked-scope report, not proof that no injuries or changes exist. Recheck before the 22:00 JST cutoff and before kickoff if official lineups appear.

modelImpact.V1: No injury/suspension/lineup adjustment. The existing model.js does not accept these news fields; uncertain secondary absence lists are not converted into numeric penalties.
modelImpact.V2: Same V1 base, then 30% Poisson baseline + 70% direct official toto vote share. No injury/suspension/lineup adjustment.
modelImpact.reason: Only Mito/Urawa suspensions and three official injury records were found; secondary absence candidates are not confirmed and current expected/official XIs are unavailable. Applying manual xG changes would violate the fixed V1/V2 definitions.

limitations: Football LAB absence lists are secondary screening only and explicitly warn that listed players may still play.
Machida/Hiroshima current preview data was not available; the available preview pages were stale (Machida 2026-09-14, Hiroshima 2026-09-07), so no stale player list was used.
For Miyazaki, no absence entry appeared in the current Tokushima/Miyazaki preview; this is not interpreted as no injuries.
Official lineups and some club-level availability/return confirmations remain uncollected.
